Title: Maxwell's Displacement Current
Script: Physics padh lo yaar! Aaj hum samjhenge Maxwell ka sabse bada game changer Displacement Current. Jab capacitor charge hota hai toh plates ke beech magnetic field kahan se aati hai? Wahan toh wire hai hi nahi! Asal mein yeh changing electric flux ka jaadu hai jo magnetic field banata hai. Yehi deep concepts IIT clear karwate hain.
